environment.description: Node.js 18 Express application deployed on EC2 instance behind a basic TCP load balancer (NLB). The jsonwebtoken library version 8.5.1 is used. The RSA public key file (rsa_public.pem) is readable by the application process. No additional request filtering or token validation middleware is present. Static files served directly by Express. Browser clients load the dashboard but SRI is only enforced client-side for script tags.
